messages:
Priya K.: FYI spotted 7 payments marked successful in Stripe but our billing pipeline never created invoices. Stripe shows webhook delivered (200) for the events. doing a quick triage now. :mag:
Tom L.: interesting that stripe shows 200. maybe our handler returns 200 before enqueueing to the processing queue? any logs from the webhook app?
Priya K.: yes, stacktrace/time window attached. webhook handler log: 
```
2026-04-06T02:14:12Z INFO Received stripe event evt_3Kxxx
2026-04-06T02:14:12Z DEBUG verify_signature ok
2026-04-06T02:14:12Z INFO responding status=200 body="ok"
2026-04-06T02:14:12Z ERROR enqueue failed err="redis: invalid password" (retries=0)
```
Notice we responded 200 BEFORE enqueue failed.
Evan G.: oh no. so Stripe thinks it succeeded and won't retry. that's the bug: we must not ack until durable enqueue confirmed.
NetSuiteAdmin: from NS side, we didn't get any create calls for those payments. if you can replay stripe events we can reprocess.
Tom L.: root cause: Redis credential rotated in k8s secret yesterday but rollout hadn't completed on one replica. the webhook pod had stale creds, so enqueue to our job queue failed but handler returned early (fast-path).
Priya K.: how many events lost? looks like 7 payment_intent.succeeded events between 02:12 and 02:16 UTC.
Evan G.: mitigation steps: 1) replay events from Stripe Dashboard for that timeframe. 2) change webhook handler to only return 2xx after enqueue returns success (or after we write a tombstone record with stripe_event_id). 3) add persistent ack queue (SQS/Kafka) as durable buffer. 4) add metric webhook_enqueue_failures and alert when >0.
Tom L.: quick patch in webhook service: 
```
// previous bad flow
verify(sig);
respond(200);
enqueue(job)

// new flow
verify(sig);
if enqueue(job) == OK {
  respond(200)
} else {
  respond(500)
}
```
I'll open PR and flag for hotfix.
Priya K.: also add unique constraint on `stripe_event_id` in billing_events table so replay is idempotent.
Evan G.: agree. for the immediate replay: I'll run Stripe's event replay tool and send events to our staging webhook endpoint first. then replay to prod once patch is live. I'll also run a reconcile script that compares stripe payments vs created invoices and flags mismatches.
StripeWebhookBot: automated note: Stripe replay available for events: https://dashboard.stripe.com/events?status=available_to_replay (7 events)
Tom L.: assigning: Tom -> webhook PR (target: staging in 1h), Evan -> stripe replay + reconcile script, Priya -> coordinate with infra to verify secret rollout and add postmortem notes.
Priya K.: infra confirms secret rollout completed at 02:20 UTC. Cron/daemonset will re-deploy replicas.
Evan G.: replay started on staging. 7 events replayed, 7 invoices created in staging NS mirror. will schedule prod replay after webhook PR merges.
Tom L.: PR 4351 created: ensures enqueue success before responding, adds 3s enqueue timeout, increments metric on failure. tests added.
Priya K.: can we also add a lightweight DB tombstone write before enqueue so we can prove we accepted the event in case of queue outages? that would help reconcile.
Tom L.: tombstone approach added to PR as optional path `tombstone_on_receive=true`. safer fallback if queue is down.
Evan G.: replay to prod completed after deploy. reconciliation results: all 7 payments resulted in invoices and journals. no manual NS edits required. closing loop with support ticket: stripe webhook delivery logs show initial delivery, no retries because we acknowledged early. Priya will draft postmortem.
Priya K.: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (secret rotation + premature 200), remediation (handler change, idempotent tombstone, metric/alert), and owner assignments. I'll file the incident and notify finance that daily recon will be delayed for <24h.
NetSuiteAdmin: thanks. if you need any manual re-syncs, ping NS support but sounds good.
Tom L.: rolling this hotfix to prod via canary (10% traffic) then 100% after 15m.
Priya K.: resolved for now, follow-up: add runbook for secret rotations to avoid partial rollouts causing ACK-before-persist. :white_check_mark:
